critical_code_review_comments: TransportPublicPage.fetchNearby: if lat/lng are undefined (refresh before geoloc), backend still receives unknowns; current call works because the API tolerates absence, but consider guarding to avoid silently sending undefined params.
AdminTransport uses window.confirm for delete (native dialog). Acceptable for admin but a Dialog component would be more consistent with the rest of the admin UI.
TransportPublicPage uses navigator.geolocation without timeout fallback announcement on first mount (announce=false); this is intentional but could log telemetry on failure for support.
